assumptions.plain: World wheat prices are not already climbing unusually fast.
assumptions.why_it_matters: The test assumes a buyer starts from an ordinary market. If prices are already moving, the cost of replacing supply is higher than the test shows, and competition for the same alternative wheat is stronger.
assumptions.if_broken: Replacing supply would cost more than this test assumes, and more buyers would be trying to do it at the same time.
assumptions.reading: World wheat price was 317.0 US$ per tonne in October 2026, moving about as it usually does.

assumptions.plain: Fertilizer costs are not adding a second shock at the same time.
assumptions.why_it_matters: A trade interruption that lands while fertilizer is also expensive hits two harvests, not one: this year's supply and next year's planting.
assumptions.if_broken: The test covers one season. A fertilizer shock extends the problem into the following season, which this test does not model.
assumptions.reading: Urea fertilizer price was 420.0 US$ per tonne in October 2026, moving about as it usually does.

assumptions.plain: The buyer could turn to another supplier.
assumptions.why_it_matters: "How much can be bought elsewhere" assumes somewhere else exists. A country that buys most of its wheat from one place has fewer doors to knock on, whatever the slider says.
assumptions.if_broken: For this country, most wheat already comes from one supplier. Treat the replacement figure as optimistic.

assumptions.plain: Households are not already absorbing a rising food bill.
assumptions.why_it_matters: The same price rise lands differently depending on how much room people already have. Where food is already taking more of a wage, there is less to give.
assumptions.if_broken: Food prices in this country are already rising faster than prices in general. A further rise would land on people with less room to absorb it.

verdict: Some assumptions do not hold for particular countries. The test says which, on each country's page. Read the test's results with that in mind.
